home.title: Codeoura — Software engineered to last
home.description: We build enterprise web platforms, cross-platform mobile apps and custom SaaS for companies that intend to still be running them in five years. Seven products live across six industries.

hero.subtitle: Most software does not fail at launch. It fails in month eighteen, when changing one thing breaks three others and nobody dares touch it. We build for month eighteen — and seven of our systems are running in production today, in six different industries. Open any of them below and use it yourself.

services.title: Five disciplines, one standard
services.subtitle: We take a system from the first architectural decision through to the deploy pipeline, and we answer for every layer in between. No handoffs, no gaps where the responsibility quietly becomes yours.

work.title: Don't take our word for it. Open one.
work.subtitle: Every project below is a system with real users, real money and real constraints behind it — and every one has a working demo you can open right now, on fabricated data. Most studios show screenshots. We hand you the keys.
work.empty: No projects in this category yet.
work.demoNote: A running copy on fabricated data. Nothing you change is saved, and no real customer data exists in it.

stack.title: The tools we will defend in a review
stack.subtitle: We do not chase frameworks. This is what we run in production, what we have watched fail at three in the morning, and what we can justify to your CTO line by line. Choosing the boring thing is a decision, not a shortage of ideas.

about.title: Engineering discipline, not delivery theatre
about.subtitle: Anyone can ship a first version. The difference shows up later — in what it costs to add the tenth feature, in whether a new engineer can read the code, in whether the thing is still fast under load it never saw on launch day. That is the part we are paid for.
about.processSubtitle: Four phases, a working deployment from the first iteration, and no invoice for a milestone you cannot click on.

contact.title: Tell us what stands in the way
contact.subtitle: Send us the problem, not a specification — the specification is usually where the wrong assumption is already buried. We read every message ourselves and reply within one business day.
